feed.title: What's New
feed.subtitle: A short, factual record of what was added to the site and when.

entry.title: Records of States, Mysteries, Questions, Teachers, Names, Stations, Terms and We Do Not Know in three languages
entry.summary: The records in these sections also open as their own pages at English and Brazilian Portuguese addresses.

entry.title: Terms: quotations and notes in English and Portuguese
entry.summary: The quotations and notes on the Terms pages now read in their own language in the English and Brazilian Portuguese versions.

entry.title: Concept pages: the record's own summary
entry.summary: Pages of concepts with no scanned occurrences in the Futuhat and the Fusus now show the record's own definition and a link to the record page.

entry.title: Side by Side Sources split into eight pages
entry.summary: The sources list was split into eight parts; the main page still holds the whole list.

entry.title: Share cards in the page's language
entry.summary: When a page is shared, the preview card appears in its own language on the English and Portuguese pages.

entry.title: Cookie banner: Decline and Accept
entry.summary: The banner shown on the first visit offers Decline and Accept for measurement side by side.

entry.title: “Essays and pieces” in the Explore menu
entry.summary: The Heart Journal and Side by Side now sit in their own group in the Explore menu instead of Settings.

entry.title: Record pages in three languages
entry.summary: Futuhat parts, Fusus chapters and Mishkat hadiths also open as their own pages at English and Brazilian Portuguese addresses.

entry.title: Heart Journal: two new pieces
entry.summary: “The mountain with its head in the cloud” and “With a shovel, in the earth” were published. The photographs are the author's and Claude wrote the words; the credit is on each piece's own page.

entry.title: Side by Side opened to search
entry.summary: The Side by Side pages were opened to search engines and the site index; a section menu, a table of contents and an on-device read mark were added.

entry.title: Side by Side in English and Portuguese
entry.summary: The Side by Side section can also be read in English and Brazilian Portuguese; the translation is our own rendering, and each page says so.

entry.title: Side by Side: Dost and Quantum Physics
entry.summary: A new section was added in which quotations from Dost are read side by side with the physics literature. It is our own reading frame, not a reading summary.

entry.title: Diagrams Archive
entry.summary: The diagrams on the site were gathered on one page with their origin stated: Dost's own hand, those we drew and our own reading frame are marked separately.

entry.title: Reading tools
entry.summary: Listen, Reading mode and paragraph notes were added to the Futuhat, Fusus and Mishkat readings. All of them run on the reader's own device.

entry.title: Heart Journal
entry.summary: A new section was added for short illustrated pieces in the author's own voice. It is not a reading summary, and every page says so.
